s: Din birkat bediqat hechametz ubo y"b seipim: qodem sheyyatchil libdoq tzarik lebarek, kemo shemmebarekin al kol mitzvot middibre soperim. Umah hu mebarek? "Baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv, vetzivvanu al biur chametz". Veap al pi shebbeshaa zo eno mebaaro adayin, mikkol maqom kevan shelleachar habbediqa miyyad hu mebattel umapqir kol hechametz shennishar bebeto shello matzeu bibdiqa zo, hare bittul zeh niqra biur kedino lechametz sheeno yadua lo shello matzeu babbediqa. Vehechametz hayyadua lo hu matznio ad lemachar, sheyyokal mimmennu ad shaa h', vehammotar mebaaro min haolam. Ubiur zeh shebbeyom y"d ubittul zeh shebbelel y"d, en mebarekin alehem kelum, vehen niptarin bibraka shebberak al habbediqa shehi techillat habbiur, lepikak mebarekin alehem "al biur chametz":

Velamma en mebarekin "al bediqat chametz" shehu matchil bah miyyad? Lepi sheen habbediqa taklit hammitzva, shehare mi shebbadaq velo bier et hechametz shemmatza babbediqa lo asa velo kelum. Veken im lo bittel chametzo achar habbediqa, adayin lo nigmera mitzvat biur chametz:

Velamma en mebarekin "shehecheyanu" qodem habbediqa, vahare hi mitzva habbaa mizzeman lizman? Lepi shemmitzva zo hi letzorek haregel, letaqqen habbayit ulebaer hechametz mittoko letzorek hammoed, lepikak hi nipteret bebirkat "shehecheyanu" shemmebarekin baregel beqiddush layla:

Im berak "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu lebaer chametz" — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Veken kayyotze bazeh bishar mitzvot shemmebarekin alehem bilshon "al", kemo "al akilat matztza", "al akilat maror", im berak alehen belame"d, "leekol matztza", "leekol maror" — yatza. Veken kol hammitzvot shemmebarekin alehen belame"d, "liqboa mezuza", "liqro et hallel", im berak bilshon "al qebiat mezuza", "al qeriat hallel" — yatza. Abal lekattechilla tzarik lebarek al kol mitzva beraka shettiqqenu lah chakamim. Vetaam shinnuy hannuschaot bebirkat hammitzvot hu meboar barishonim, ayyen sham:

Im shakach lebarek qodem hatchalat habbediqa, im nizkar qodem sheggamar et habbediqa legamre, dehaynu shennishar lo adayin libdoq maqom echad, o apillu zavit achat, vaapillu chor echad (im hu beinyan sheyyesh lachosh shemma yesh sham bachor kezzayit chametz ayyen siman tm"v) — chayyab lebarek qodem sheyyigmor bediqa zo. Abal im nizkar leachar sheggamar bediqato legamre — lo yebarek kelum, shekkol hammitzvot mebarekin alehem ober laasiyyatan, abal leachar gemar asiyyatan heak yebarek. Vetzivvanu laasot mitzva pelonit, veeno oseh kelum, shekkebar asa. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap al pi ken yebarek lemachar besop shaa h' keshessorep et hechametz shemmatza babbediqa, shehare serepa zo iqqar biur chametz, vehaya rauy lebarek aleha, ella sheppoterin otah bebirkat "al biur chametz" shemmebarekin bishat bediqa, vezeh shello berak bishat bediqa — tzarik lebarek bishat hasserepa. Veyesh lachosh lebarek otah belo shem umalkut:

Asur lehapsiq beshum dibbur ben habberaka litchillat habbediqa, kederek sheasur lehapsiq bishar kol hammitzvot ben habberaka litchillat asiyyat hammitzvot. Ulekattechilla yizzaher shello yedabber benetayim kelal, apillu meinyene tzorke habbediqa, ella im ken hu beinyan shei epshar lo lehatchil libdoq im lo yasiach. Abal im abar vesach benetayim betzorke habbediqa en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, apillu haya epshar libdoq belo sicha zo. Abal im sach benetayim sicha sheenah meinyan habbediqa kelal — tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshessach qodem shehitchil libdoq, abal im sach leachar shehitchil libdoq en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan shekkebar hitchil bammitzva shebberak aleha (ayyen siman tqtz"b). Veken im holek ubodeq mecheder lecheder umibbayit lebayit — en halika zo shebbeemtza mitzva chashuba hepseq lehatzriko lachazor ulebarek, kemo sheen hassicha shebbeemtza mitzva chashuba hepseq. Umikkol maqom lekattechilla en lehasiach shum sicha beemtza habbediqa apillu bedibre tora, ki im meinyene tzorke habbediqa, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheap hammesiach beemtza hammitzva hare zeh hepseq vetzarik lachazor ulebarek kesheyyigmor hammitzva. Veeno domeh lemesiach beemtza seudato kesheyyosheb bassukka sheen tzarik lachazor ulebarek "lesheb bassukka", lepi sheeno mukrach bishiba zo shelleachar hassicha, sheim yirtzeh shello leekol od veshello lesheb bassukka hareshut beyado, abal bibdiqat chametz mukrach hu ligmor et habbediqa shelleachar hassicha, shechayyab libdoq bekol hammeqomot shemmaknisin bahen chametz, veillu haya shokeach lebarek bitchillat bediqato haya chayyab lebarek bigmar bediqato, laken gam akshav chayyab lachazor ulebarek, kevan shehipsiq besicha achar beraka harishona, veken kayyotze bazeh bishar kol mitzvot shehen choba vei epshar leadam liptor et atzmo mehen:

Chobat habbediqa hi al baal habbayit, abal bene beto haokelim mishshello en chiyyub habbediqa chal alehem kelal (ella im ken en haish bebeto kemo sheyyitbaer siman tl"v), kevan sheen hechametz shellahem. Abal im baal habbayit rotzeh laasot bene beto sheluchim lidbar mitzva sheyyibdequ hem — hareshut beyado, vibareku hem birkat "al biur chametz". Umikkol maqom nakon haddabar sheyyibdoq hu beatzmo, shekken hu bekol hammitzvot "mitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho". Veim eno yakol litroach beatzmo libdoq bekol hachadarim ubekol hammeqomot, yibdoq hu cheder echad o zavit achat, veyaamid mibbene beto etzlo beshaa shemmebarek al bediqato vikavven lehotziam bebirkato, vehem yaanu "amen" achar birkato veyitkavvenu latzet bebirkato, veyitpazzeru libdoq ish ish limqomo. Veyizzaharu shemmiyyad achar sheshshameu habberaka yatchilu libdoq bachadarim hassemukim labbayit sheshshameu habberaka betoko, abal lo yeleku miyyad lebayit acher libdoq, lepi shehahalika mibbayit lebayit chashuba hepseq ben habberaka litchillat asiyyat hammitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman ch' ayyen sham:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad sheaberu vehipsiqu ben shemiat habberaka litchillat habbediqa, o apillu lo shameu kelal et habberaka mibbaal habbayit, enan tzerikim lebarek al bediqatam, kevan shehem atzmam enam chayyabim bibdiqa zo, veenan bodeqin ella kede liptor et baal habbayit mechiyyubo, vekevan shebbaal habbayit beatzmo im haya bodeq gam otan hammeqomot shebbene beto bodeqin lo haya mechuyyab lachazor ulebarek al otan hammeqomot kevan shekkebar berak paam achat, lepikak gam bene beto sheosim shelichuto enam chayyabin lebarek. Umikkol maqom lekattechilla en lahem libdoq belo shemiat habberaka, shehare hem osim mitzva, veen laasot mitzva belo beraka lepaneha:

Keshehu rotzeh laasot shaliach libdiqat chametz, yakol laasot apillu ebed o ishsha, o qatan sheyyesh bo daat vikolet libdoq kekol mishpete habbediqa sheyyitbaaru besiman tl"g, shehakkol kesherim libdiqat chametz, vehakkol neemanim al habbediqa, veen chosheshin shemma yitatztzelu libdoq yapeh vishaqqeru lomar "yapeh badaqnu", dekevan shebbediqat chametz eno ella middibre soperim, shemmin hattora day bebittul bilbad kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"a, lepikak heeminum chakamim, vehem ameru libdoq vehem ameru shehallalu neemanim al habbediqa. (Veap al gab dekol heka deitchazzaq issura derabbanan en haqqatan neeman lomar "tiqqanti haissur", kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qk"z, vehaka nammi itchazzaq issura, shehabbayit hu male chametz kol hashshana, apillu haki neeman haqqatan lomar "biarti hechametz min habbayit", hoil vehaya beyado lebaer, vekol dabar shehaya beyado laasoto neeman lomar sheasaah, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham ubesiman q"k ayyen sham). Umikkol maqom mitzva min hammubchar shello lismok lekattechilla bibdiqato ella al anashim bene chorin shehiggiu liklal hammitzvot, dehaynu mi"g shana vaelak, lepi shehabbediqa kehilkatah yesh bah torach gadol, veyesh lachosh shemma yitatztzelu velo yibdequ yapeh:

Hannohagim lehanniach petite chametz babbayit bekamma meqomot qodem bediqat habbodeq, yizzaharu lehanniach chametz qasheh sheeno mitparer, shemma yitparer mimmennu meat veyishshaer mimmennu babbayit bepesach. Vegam yizzaharu leshomro shello yigreru mimmennu akbarim o qetannim, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman tl"d. Umeiqqar haddin en tzarik kelal lehanniach petitim hallalu qodem bediqa, sheap im yibdoq habbodeq velo yimtza shum chametz bibdiqato, ap al pi ken lo berak lebattala, shekkak hammitzva libdoq hechametz ulechappes acharayv shemma yimtza mimmennu meuma, veim lo matza en bekak kelum, ukebar qiyyem hammitzva ketiqqunah. Abal kebar nitpashshet hamminhag lehannichan, uminhagan shel yisrael tora hi:

Yesh mehamdaqdeqim littol yedehem qodem habbediqa. Veap al pi shehannotel yadayv bemaqom shello tiqqenu hachakamim hare zeh miggasse haruach, mikkol maqom meachar shebbediqat chametz hi baa letohorat haregel kemo shennitbaer lemala, im ken mitzva chashuba hi, ureuya lihyot binqiyyut.
